design:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a HIGH FIDELITY GAME UI DESIGN BOARD, exactly six separate LANDSCAPE 16:9 screenshots arranged in a precise two-column, three-row grid, overall landscape 3:~2 canvas. Large sharp 2400x2025 or equivalent high resolution. Each panel is a fully designed mobile game interface from the same Chinese comedy Three Kingdoms game 主公快跑, showing progressive disclosure and beautiful art. Input reference is the USER-APPROVED VISUAL DESIGN: faithful painterly warm sunset ancient camp, energetic ink outlines, comic Liu Bei and Zhang Fei, warm cream parchment, confident dark brush headings, restrained hand-painted gold buttons. Preserve its beauty and polish. This board will be THE SPEC for implementation, not a mood board. No generic dark green dashboard, no web admin cards, no tiny busy information.

Panel 1 TOP LEFT: HOME / CHEST, unify camp home and treasure experience, full bleed referenced camp, Liu Bei and Zhang Fei LARGE on the right, on the left heading “长坂大营”, smaller “曹军的宝箱，姓刘了！”, a beautiful real wooden treasure chest with gilt straps centrally at lower left and warm little glints, main large gold button “开宝箱 · 50”, quieter ivory button beside it “编队出征”. Gold counter in top right “0”. ONLY TWO PRIMARY ENTRIES: chest and squad. No equipment or intel top-level entry. No additional main menu. One comic speech balloon “三弟，先开箱！”
Panel 2 TOP RIGHT: SQUAD PAGE “整军出征”, quieter illustrated Shu tent/background, SIX beautiful tall ivory hand-painted parchment cards in one row, four filled with large expressive full-body 张飞、长枪兵、弓箭手、拒马, last two clean empty slots plus signs. Large enough to recognize immediately, no second inventory collection below. small header “已携带 4 / 6”, back button upper left. At bottom one obvious gold “出征” button. Tap an occupied card opens detail; tap empty opens a separate picker. Mobile comfortable spacing.
Panel 3 MIDDLE LEFT: UNIT DETAIL “关羽”, FULL PAGE, not a tiny sidebar. An impressive very large fierce comic Guanyu and weapon on left over atmospheric green camp flag; right a warm lightly textured parchment scroll with clean type, title “关羽”, role “近战群攻”, short skill “青龙横扫”, description “每 9 秒自动施放”. Just three quietly styled numeric readouts “军饷 160” “生命 340” “伤害 26”, no grid of rounded green metric tiles. Gold “带上出征” button and small “装配” button. Back arrow top left.
Panel 4 MIDDLE RIGHT: CHEST REVEAL, same camp blurred softly by illustrated atmospheric haze, giant single parchment prize card with Guanyu front and center against restrained golden rays, heading “开出好兄弟！”, rarity “名品”, name “关羽”. Two bottom actions “收下” gold, “查看装配” ivory. Focus on anticipation and reward, no casino/neon or currency purchases. This is in-game coins only.
Panel 5 BOTTOM LEFT: CARD PICKER / EQUIPMENT, airy ivory scroll table with heading “选一位兄弟”, a small filter row “已拥有 / 武将 / 兵种 / 器械”, one generously spaced horizontal selection of 4 large illustrated cards, good readable names. Minimal pagespace; no permanent sidebar. All actual inventory is in separate screen, never duplicated with active squad. Single back arrow.
Panel 6 BOTTOM RIGHT: BATTLE END RESULT with large funny fleeing Liu Bei and indignant Zhang Fei, sunset, big calligraphic heading “主公又跑了！”, one meaningful gold reward “+60 金币”, clear primary “回营开箱”, secondary “再跑一回”. Hand-painted parchment small panel, leave characters dominant. Visual language can also carry pause/settings overlays in same parchment frame.

Treat each panel as a real screenshot, no exterior text labels except panel UI, no phone frames. Larger character illustrations, stylish readable Chinese typography, clean hierarchy, breathing room and coherent individual screens. Parchment buttons with subtly irregular edges, ink shadows, original reference art materials. Preserve approved character identity and old-world comical flavor. All six interfaces must look like they belong to the approved reference, not a different flat UI theme.
backgrounds:
Use case: compositing / production UI asset extraction. Derive production background artwork DIRECTLY from the two supplied approved render designs. Output exactly TWO landscape 16:9 backgrounds stacked vertically, full canvas 16:18 portrait aspect ratio, ideally 1536x1728. Top background fills exact top half. Bottom background fills exact bottom half. No margins or gaps between halves. Both independent images must be edge-to-edge.

TOP HALF: faithful recreation of the first reference's warm sunset Changban camp with very large comic Liu Bei in pale yellow and green holding a travel bundle and broad indignant Zhang Fei in red and black with snake spear on the RIGHT HALF only, as first reference, preserve their faces and illustration style. Character feet around 90% of their scene height. On left 45% retain distant hazy mountains, sunset, tents and camp ground but simplify contrast to support overlaid UI, creamy pale atmospheric sky at top-left for dark heading, ground with no large foreground props center-left so a chest will be overlaid there. Full scene with warm light, strong ink line art, refined painted details. NO chest here (will be a separate animated overlay). NO speech balloon, NO heading, NO logo, NO counters, NO buttons, NO text of any kind except the historic “蜀” flag is allowed. Preserve the approved scene's rich painterly rendering and atmospheric depth. Background output only.

BOTTOM HALF: SAME scene's camp with NO foreground characters, no treasure chest, no UI and no text except “蜀” on green flags. Peaceful sunset Shu encampment avenue with linen tents, timber gate, distant mountains and wall, lanterns and soldier silhouettes far away; symmetrical enough for a row of six cards in the middle. Middle 75% deliberately low visual contrast and uncluttered, side edges richly drawn, warm evening gold and muted blue gray. NOT a photo or 3D. This is the quiet backdrop used beneath parchment cards and detail scrolls, directly following the squad and detail renders in reference 2.

Important: both artworks are scene layers extracted from the render designs, not invented UI. Remove ALL baked-in UI and lettering. Do not render any grid cards, title, interface frame, numbers or menus. Respect exact two evenly sized horizontal halves so this image can be cropped at 50% height.
kit:
Use case: production UI asset extraction from supplied render design, precise-object-edit.
Produce ONE transparent PNG ASSET ATLAS containing exactly eight isolated reusable painted objects taken from this rendered game UI design. Reference 1 = completed six screen design spec. Reference 2 = original approved render for materials. These are production slices derived from those designs, not a new visual style.

Layout: exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows. Overall 2:1 canvas, ideally 2048x1024, each cell 512 square. Every object fits inside its own cell with 25 pixel clear transparent padding. Transparent alpha background, no checkerboard or grid lines. Items in reading order:

Row1 col1: wide horizontal golden ochre parchment button plate with beautifully hand-painted embossed irregular gold border and black ink shadow, EXACT SAME as main gold buttons in references. EMPTY center without text. Object about 460x170 within square.
Row1 col2: wide horizontal ivory parchment secondary button, thin brown ink outline, subtle worn corners, same dimensions as gold. EMPTY no symbols/text.
Row1 col3: tall vertical ivory parchment collectible/card frame, elegant slightly ragged edge, minimal brown corner detail; empty warm cream paper center. About310x455.
Row1 col4: large nearly-square warm ivory scroll/paper panel used for character description, small curled parchment corners, beautiful subtle fibrous texture, ink edge. EMPTY center. About460x455.
Row2 col1: round ink-black back button with a thin irregular antique gold circular rim and one large ivory chevron pointing LEFT. About160 square, plenty of transparent space. EXACT reference top-left button.
Row2 col2: horizontal black dry-brush ink swash to use behind headings, ragged bristle edges and natural splatters, about460x190. EMPTY no words, same brushwork as game logo backing.
Row2 col3: ONE gold coin with stylized central hole and embossed rim, three-quarter face view, warm painted highlight, thick dark ink outline; about190x210. No number or lettering.
Row2 col4: magnificent CLOSED wooden treasure chest from top-left screen reference, hand-painted dark walnut wood, rich gold bands, rivets, ornate lion latch, soft gold light leaking from lid seam. Three-quarter front view facing slightly right, full chest about440x350. Do NOT include any background/ground or particles/glow outside the object. No text. This will animate independently.

All objects must be genuinely transparent around their silhouettes, fully separated, no contact between cells. No cast shadows extending to cell borders. Keep paper interiors opaque. Crisp painterly artwork consistent with approved game, NO vector-only or flat minimalist replacements. No type labels around the atlas, no annotations, no watermark. Faithfully preserve the designed UI ornament/material shapes.
